Subject: RE: Ostrem Logistics - New Submission

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the submission on Ostrem Logistics! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

I have a few questions before I can finalize the quote:

- Can you confirm the primary operations at each location?
- What are the building construction types and year built for both facilities?
- Are there any fire protection systems (sprinklers, alarms) in place?
- Any planned renovations or expansions in the next 12 months?

Once I have these details, I'll work up a competitive proposal for you. Looking at a 2026-12-29 effective date, so we have good timing.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
